content.title: Danone No Longer Interested in Buying Lifeway Foods. What Could Happen Next.
content.summary: The French dairy company  Danone  is no longer seeking to buy kefir maker  Lifeway Foods  according to a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.  The two companies had entered into an agreement on Aug. 1, to allow  Danone  to conduct due diligence for a potential buyout.  In the SEC filing, Danone said it was exploring other options, which could include offloading all or part of its stake in Lifeway or retaining its full investment.
